name: FNB
verdict: FNB is a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of JSE-listed FirstRand Limited. No state owner in the chain and no qualifying human-rights finding found. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of the Springboks since the March 2025 announcement (first worn vs Italy, 5 July 2025); the gold FNB logo sits centre chest on the 2026/27 home jersey. Rated in the rugby-south-africa rating sweep (issue #727).
